ns2:section.sectionText: This course will introduce basic concepts of infectious disease modeling and epidemiology, with an emphasis on the use of mathematical models. The topics that are going to be covered include infectious disease studies, the transmission dynamics of human pathogens with different transmission routes, modeling approaches to understand disease outbreaks, ways in which mathematical models can be used to understand the mechanisms driving infectious disease dynamics, and the impacts of public health interventions.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Statistics or Statistics & Computer Science major(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
